dialogDescription: Choose an agent, what it works on and when.
title: Title

invalidTimezone: Enter a time zone such as Europe/Berlin.
name: Name

loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
noAgentsHint: A schedule hands work to one of the project's agents.
